# halos_rollouts (Data Source)

Rollouts defined in policy with the controller's current step (GET /api/v1/rollouts). Read only: advancing or rolling back a rollout is a human decision.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_rollouts" "this" {}

output "halted_rollouts" {
  value = [for r in data.halos_rollouts.this.rollouts : r.name if r.halted != ""]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `rollouts`.
- `rollouts` (Attributes List) Rollouts in policy order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rollouts))

<a id="nestedatt--rollouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rollouts`

Read-Only:

- `axis` (String) `client` or `gateway`.
- `experiment` (String) The experiment the rollout drives.
- `halt_reason` (String) Why it halted.
- `halted` (String) Non-empty when the controller halted the rollout.
- `name` (String) Rollout name.
- `status` (String) Rollout status, for example `draft` or `running`.
- `step` (Number) Index of the current step; 0 when the controller has not started it.
- `step_name` (String) Name of the current step; empty when not started.
